blur_latched_directional_operational_Q_s.latch: after T_d the component remains active at every remaining effective checkpoint; later B values do not close it
blur_latched_directional_operational_Q_s.remaining_count: h_d=h_d(T_d) is frozen at the predictable first hit
blur_latched_directional_operational_Q_s.implemented_whitened_shift: at start use u=sqrt(2*kappa_d)*w/||w||; after start refresh to the current normalized direction whenever ||w||>=1e-8, otherwise reuse the most recent valid whitened unit direction and still set ||u||=sqrt(2*kappa_d)
blur_latched_directional_operational_Q_s.semantic_choice: fixed-information directional Q*: normalization may amplify a small-but-above-floor direction and therefore intentionally changes the alternative rather than recovering the ideal high-noise marginal
blur_latched_directional_operational_Q_s.future_direction_below_floor: reuse the most recent valid unit direction; the qualifying start guarantees such a direction already exists; record every fallback step

forbidden_method_inputs: human, model, or adjudicated visual labels/reviews
falsification_and_stop_rules: Any start, h, kappa, mask, direction, or normalized u that changes when current/future innovation is replaced invalidates predictability.

Any confirmation threshold not frozen on disjoint calibration paths invalidates fresh-rank, pre-label mechanics GO, and confirmatory quality claims; operational LR exactness fails specifically if the threshold or shift reads the current innovation.
Any started path missing one of its h fixed-information increments fails the complete-coverage mechanics gate.
Fewer than 12 starts or fewer than three started classes at either scale stops E before labels.
Exact Q*/P accounting alone is not image-quality evidence and never authorizes intervention.
No confirmation-label failure may be rescued by changing floor, start depth, K, B gate, mask, heat shift, mixture weight, or ablation.
